overview.description: The JPMorgan Equity Premium Income ETF (JEPI) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is an actively-managed fund that invests in large-cap US stocks and equity-linked notes (ELNs). It seeks to provide similar returns as the S&P 500 Index with lower volatility and monthly income. JEPI was launched on May 20, 2020 and is issued by JPMorgan Chase.
